verified_behavior: Complete TLS-authenticated HTTP 401/403/429 replies are retained with their status and release the miner hold after durable evidence writes. Usage remains null, not fabricated zero.
HTTP 500 and missing/incomplete usage keep the admission hold, including after witness restart.
One matching completed/failed/incomplete terminal SSE event with valid nonnegative, consistent token counts records usage and permits another call.
Incomplete or ambiguous HTTP framing and missing, conflicting or invalid terminal usage do not resolve spending.
A subscription token expiring during simulated admission is refreshed before provider TLS, without another allocation or inference retry.
Failed credential refresh preserves the exchange ID and attempts to release the unused worker before sending any TLS/provider request.
The queued worker removes the active lock when an unused client closes before its ClientHello.
Rejected response recovery returns the original HTTP status and performs no inference.

existing_holds: Previously unresolved exchanges are not automatically cleared; operator reconciliation still required
